cues.en: Very passable, Lissy. Very passable. Aye. Aye. Aye. Aye.
cues.zh: 相当凑合了，Lissy。挺过得去的。是啊。是啊。是啊。是啊。

cues.en: Aye.
cues.zh: 是啊。

cues.en: Aye. Who would have thought thirty years ago,
cues.zh: 是啊。三十年前谁能想得到呢，

cues.en: we'd all be sitting here drinking Chateau de Chasseleur,
cues.zh: 我们如今能坐在这儿喝着 Chateau de Chasseleur，

cues.en: Them days, we're glad to have the price of a cup of tea. Aye. A cup of cold tea. Without milk or sugar or tea.
cues.zh: 那时候，能买得起一杯茶就乐开花了。是啊。一杯放凉的茶。没奶、没糖，甚至都没茶叶。

cues.en: In a cracked cup and all?
cues.zh: 还是用缺了口的破杯子装的吧？

cues.en: Oh, we never used to have a cup. We used to have to drink out of a roll up newspaper.
cues.zh: 哦，我们以前连杯子都没有。只能卷张报纸捧着喝。

cues.en: The best we could manage was to suck on a piece of damp cloth.
cues.zh: 我们那会儿最好的条件，也就是嘬一块湿布。

cues.en: But, you know, we were happy in those days, although we were poor. Because we were poor. Aye. My old dad used to say to me, money doesn't bring you happiness, son. It was right. Aye. I was happier then, and I had nothing.
cues.zh: 不过，你知道，那时候我们虽然穷，却很快乐。因为我们穷。是啊。我爸以前常对我说，孩子，钱买不来幸福。这话没错。是啊。那时候我更快乐，虽然我一无所有。

cues.en: We used to live in this tiny old tumble down house with great big holes in the roof. House, you were lucky to live in a house. We used to live in one room, all 26 of us, no furniture, half the floor was missing. We're all uddled together in one corner for fear of falling. You
cues.zh: 我们那时住在一栋破破烂烂的小房子里，屋顶上全是大窟窿。房子？你能住上房子算你走运了。我们那时就住一个房间，我们26个人全挤在里面，没有家具，地板还缺了一半。我们都缩在一个角落里，怕掉下去。你

cues.en: were lucky to have a room. We used to have to live in the corridor.
cues.zh: 能有个房间算走运了。我们那时只能住在走廊里。

cues.en: Oh, we used to dream of living in a corridor.
cues.zh: 哦，我们以前梦想着住在走廊里。

cues.en: Would have been a palace to us.
cues.zh: 对我们来说，那简直就是宫殿。

cues.en: We used to live in an old water tank on a rubbish tip.
cues.zh: 我们以前住在垃圾堆上的一座旧水箱里。

cues.en: We got woke up every morning by having a load of rotting fish dumped all over us.
cues.zh: 每天早上，一堆腐烂的鱼倒在我们身上，把我们弄醒。

cues.en: House. Well,
cues.zh: 房子。嗯，

cues.en: when I say house, it was just a hole in the ground covered by a sheet of tarpaulin,
cues.zh: 我说是房子，其实只是地上的一个坑，上面盖着防水布，

cues.en: but it was a house to us.
cues.zh: 但对我们来说，那就是房子。

cues.en: We were evicted from our hole in the ground.
cues.zh: 我们被赶出了地上的坑。

cues.en: We had to go and live in a lake.
cues.zh: 只好去湖里住。

cues.en: You were lucky to have a lake. There were a 150 of us living in a shoebox in the middle of the road.
cues.zh: 你们有湖住就算走运了。我们当时 150 个人挤在大马路中间的一个鞋盒里。

cues.en: Cardboard box. Aye. You were lucky.
cues.zh: 纸箱子，是啊，你们可算走运了。

cues.en: We lived for three months in a rolled up newspaper in a septic tank.
cues.zh: 我们在化粪池里的一卷报纸里住了整整三个月。

cues.en: You just have to get up every morning at 06:00 and clean the newspaper, go to work down the mill, fourteen hours a day, week in, week out for six months a week. And when we got home, our dad would thrash us to sleep with his belt.
cues.zh: 每天早上六点就得起床把报纸清理干净，然后去厂里干活，一天十四个小时，一周干六天，年复一年。等回了家，老爹还会用皮带把我们抽打到睡着。

cues.en: Luxury.
cues.zh: 奢侈。

cues.en: We used to have to get out of the lake at 03:00 in the morning, clean the lake, eat a handful of hot gravel, work twenty hours a day at mill for twopence a month, come home, and dad would beat us around the head and neck with a broken bottle if we were lucky.
cues.zh: 我们以前凌晨三点就得从湖里出来，打扫湖面，吃一把滚烫的碎石，在工厂每天干二十个小时，一个月才挣两便士，回到家，要是运气好，爸爸还会用破瓶子打我们的头和脖子。

cues.en: Well, of course, we had it tough.
cues.zh: 唉，当然了，我们那时候日子可难了。

cues.en: We used to have to get them out of the shoebox in the middle of the night and lick the road clean with our tongues.
cues.zh: 我们以前半夜还得把他们从鞋盒里弄出来，用舌头把路舔干净。

cues.en: We had to eat half a 100 for the freezing cold gravel, worked twenty four hours of that mill for four months every six years, and when we got home, our dad would slash in two with a bread knife.
cues.zh: 我们得在冰冷的碎石地上吃掉半个一百，连续四个月、每隔六年就得在那家工厂干满二十四小时。回到家后，爸爸还会用面包刀把我们劈成两半。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 没错。

cues.en: I
cues.zh: 我

cues.en: had to get up in the morning at 10:00 at night, half an hour before I went to bed,
cues.zh: 得早上十点起床——就在我睡觉前半小时，

cues.en: eat a lump of coal poison, work twenty nine hours a day down mill, and pay mill owner for permission to come to work. And when we got home,
cues.zh: 吃下一块有毒的煤，一天在工厂干二十九个小时，还得付钱给厂主，才准我们去上工。回到家后，

cues.en: our dad would kill us and dance about in our grave singing hallelujah.
cues.zh: 爸爸会杀了我们，还会在我们的坟头上跳舞，唱着哈利路亚。

cues.en: Are
cues.zh: 你是

cues.en: you trying to tell the young people of today that,
cues.zh: 想跟现在的年轻人说这些，

cues.en: And they won't believe you. No. They won't.
cues.zh: 他们是不会相信你的。对，他们才不信。
